rationale: dashboard-create-alert.spec.js already exercises the alert context menu (right-click -> menu -> above/below -> alert form) for bar and line series and owns the reusable page-object helpers (rightClickChartForAlert, expectAlertContextMenuVisible, selectAlertAbove/BelowThreshold). This feature only adds 'scatter' to the CONTEXT_MENU_SERIES_TYPES whitelist, so the missing coverage is exactly the scatter-series path and the non-cartesian no-menu guard. Both fit as new test() cases in the existing spec — no new file, no new registration. The non-cartesian no-menu assertion is not currently covered by dashboard-pie-donut.spec.js (it only checks chart canvas rendering).
